title: Functional Consultant-F&O
jobDescription: Are you a passionate Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Functional Consultant looking to grow in enterprise application implementation, functional consulting, and digital transformation? Join Level Shift as a D365 F&O Functional Consultant, where you’ll work with customers, project managers, technical consultants, and cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, configure D365 Finance and Supply Chain Management solutions, and support implementation, documentation, training, UAT, production support, and continuous improvement. What You'll Do As a D365 F&O Functional Consultant at Level Shift, you will: • Understand customer requirements, business processes, technical challenges, and transformation objectives. • Design, configure, document, demonstrate, and support D365 Finance and SCM solutions based on client needs. • Prepare functional documentation, training materials, process documents, and user guides, and review technical documentation for alignment. • Support implementation, testing, UAT, issue resolution, production support, post-go-live activities, and solution handover. • Conduct demos, workshops, functional advisory sessions, end-user training, and adoption support. • Collaborate with project managers, delivery teams, technical consultants, and business users to ensure smooth delivery and customer alignment. • Support pre-sales through proposal inputs, demos, solution inputs, effort estimation support, and customer discussions. • Provide daily status reports covering progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and action items. • Mentor junior resources, support knowledge sharing, and assist the Project Manager with interviews, recruitment, and organizational initiatives. • Contribute to formal trainings, certifications, blogs, whitepapers, continuous learning, and skill enhancement. • Recommend tools, automation opportunities, and process improvements to improve project and team efficiency. • Follow information security policies, report security events or weaknesses, and participate in BCP and fire drill exercises as applicable. How this role uses AI • Use AI tools responsibly to improve productivity, accelerate documentation, analyze requirements, automate repetitive tasks, generate insights, and improve implementation efficiency. • Apply AI-assisted tools for requirement analysis, functional/configuration documentation, test cases, training content, status reports, proposal inputs, issue analysis, solution recommendations, and presentations. • Leverage Microsoft Copilot, Dynamics 365 Copilot, Power Platform AI, Agents, Azure AI Services, and cloud-based AI tools to improve business processes, customer outcomes, and consulting productivity. Your Skillset • Strong experience as a D365 F&O Functional Consultant with hands-on expertise in D365 Finance and SCM implementation, configuration, documentation, training, UAT, production support, and post-go-live support. • Functional knowledge of D365 Finance modules, SCM capabilities, finance and supply chain processes, workflows, integrations, enterprise applications, and Microsoft business application ecosystems. • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable functional solutions and align functional design with technical delivery. • Experience in requirement gathering, solution validation, testing, user training, issue resolution, continuous improvement, and customer-facing workshops or demos. • Ability to prepare functional documentation, review technical documentation, support pre-sales, and contribute to proposals, demos, solution inputs, and effort estimation. • Exposure to Microsoft cloud platforms, Copilot, Agents, Power Platform AI, AI-assisted productivity tools, automation, and emerging enterprise technologies is desirable. • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, documentation, negotiation, risk identification, and dependency management skills. • Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to recruitment, interviews, trainings, certifications, blogs, whitepapers, process improvement, information security, compliance, responsible AI adoption, and operational excellence. Why Level Shift? • Grow your career through enterprise-scale D365 Finance & Operations, SCM, implementation, support, and digital transformation initiatives. • Gain exposure to cloud platforms, Copilot, Agents, AI-assisted tools, automation, and modern Microsoft business application ecosystems. • Work with experienced consultants, project managers, technical specialists, and cross-functional teams in a collaborative, innovation-focused environment. • Build strong functional consulting expertise across configuration, documentation, UAT, production support, pre-sales support, stakeholder engagement, and customer success. • Access continuous learning, certification support, formal trainings, leadership development, and exposure to emerging AI-powered enterprise technologies.

title: Senior Software Engineer-Data
jobDescription: Are you a passionate and enthusiastic data professional looking to build your career in data engineering, business intelligence, and analytics? Join Level Shift as a Senior Software Engineer , where you'll design scalable data solutions, build modern analytics platforms, and transform data into actionable business insights. You'll collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analytics teams to deliver secure, high-quality, and cloud-enabled data solutions that drive informed decision-making across the enterprise. What You'll Do As a Senior Software Engineer at Level Shift, you will: • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data models and data warehouses to support enterprise reporting and analytics requirements. • Build reports using Power BI, Tableau, to deliver meaningful business insights. • Develop and manage ETL/ELT pipelines to enable efficient data integration, transformation, and processing across multiple data sources. • Implement data quality, governance, security controls, and access management practices to ensure trusted and compliant data environments. • Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to gather requirements, optimize data workflows, and support cloud-based data modernization initiatives. How this role uses AI • Should be comfortable using AI tools to enhance analytics workflows, automate repetitive tasks, generate insights, and improve productivity while ensuring data governance and security. • Utilize AI-assisted data preparation, dashboard generation, anomaly detection, predictive analytics, documentation, and code generation to accelerate solution delivery. • Leverage AI-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Azure AI services, Git Hub Copilot, and cloud-native analytics platforms to build intelligent and data-driven solutions. Your Skillset • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. • 3+ years of experience in data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, or related data platform roles. • Strong hands-on experience in data modeling, dimensional modeling, and data warehousing concepts. • Expertise in reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau. • Experience implementing data-level security, role-based access controls, and data governance frameworks. • Hands-on knowledge of ETL/ELT frameworks, data integration processes, and pipeline orchestration. • Strong understanding of Data Quality Management principles and best practices. • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms like Azure • Strong SQL skills with experience querying and optimizing large datasets. • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions. • Passion for continuous learning and staying current with emerging data technologies, cloud services, and AI-driven analytics. • Knowledge of Python for data analysis, automation, or analytical model development is an added advantage. • Experience with modern data architectures, cloud data warehouses, predictive analytics, and Agile methodologies is highly desirable.

title: Software Engineer - AI
jobDescription: Are you a passionate and enthusiastic AI professional looking to build your career in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and intelligent automation? Join Level Shift as an AI Engineer , where you'll design AI-native solutions, build intelligent automation pipelines, and develop next-generation AI applications that solve real business problems. You'll collaborate with product teams, software engineers, data professionals, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and production-ready AI solutions that accelerate digital transformation. What You'll Do As an AI Engineer at Level Shift , you will: Build intelligent pipelines utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) for reasoning, document generation, summarization, content extraction, and task automation. Design and develop autonomous AI workflows where AI agents interact with tools, APIs, memory, external systems, and other agents to solve complex business problems using Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and planning techniques. Analyze and modernize existing enterprise applications, rule-based systems, stored procedures, and legacy workflows into AI-native solutions capable of processing structured and unstructured data. Develop secure, scalable, and production-ready AI applications by integrating LLMs with enterprise systems, cloud platforms, databases, and business processes while following responsible AI and governance best practices. Collaborate with internal teams and customer-facing stakeholders to identify AI adoption opportunities, recommend innovative solutions, and continuously improve business processes through intelligent automation. How this role uses AI Utilize Generative AI throughout the software development lifecycle to accelerate development, automate repetitive engineering tasks, improve documentation, and enhance productivity. Leverage AI-powered tools for prompt optimization, code generation, workflow automation, testing, reasoning, and intelligent knowledge retrieval. Work with modern AI technologies such as Azure Open AI, Microsoft Copilot, Git Hub Copilot, Lang Chain, Semantic Kernel, vector databases, and AI agent frameworks to build enterprise-grade AI solutions. Your Skillset Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field with 3+ years of experience in AI Engineering, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or Generative AI. Strong hands-on experience building applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and AI agent frameworks such as Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Semantic Kernel, Crew AI, or Auto Gen. Proficiency in Python , REST APIs, cloud platforms (preferably Azure), and integrating AI services with enterprise applications, databases, and business systems. Good understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, model evaluation, security, structured and unstructured data processing, and modern AI application architectures. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with a passion for learning emerging AI technologies, collaborating in Agile teams, and delivering scalable AI-driven business solutions.

title: Solution Architect - Presales
jobDescription: Are you a passionate and enthusiastic enterprise architect looking to build your career in solutioning, pre-sales, and digital transformation? Join Level Shift as a Solution Architect – Pre-Sales, where you'll design scalable enterprise solutions, drive business growth, and help customers achieve their digital transformation goals. You'll collaborate with sales teams, customers, and technical experts to architect innovative solutions across cloud, enterprise applications, AI, and automation technologies. What You'll Do As a Solution Architect – Pre-Sales at Level Shift, you will: • Engage with customers to understand business requirements, technical challenges, and transformation objectives while identifying value-driven solution opportunities. • Collaborate with sales teams during RFP, RFI, and RFQ processes by preparing technical proposals, solution designs, and effort estimations. • Design end-to-end enterprise solution architectures across cloud platforms, CRM, ERP, AI, automation, and integration ecosystems. • Conduct client presentations, workshops, demos, and technical advisory sessions to communicate solution value and business outcomes. • Work closely with delivery and technical teams to ensure solution feasibility, smooth handover, and strategic alignment with customer goals. How this role uses AI • Should be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate solution design, automate repetitive tasks, generate insights, and improve productivity while ensuring responsible AI adoption and governance. • Utilize AI-assisted proposal generation, requirement analysis, architecture documentation, effort estimation, solution recommendations, and presentation preparation to enhance pre-sales efficiency. • Leverage AI-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, Git Hub Copilot, Power Platform AI capabilities, and enterprise AI frameworks to build intelligent, future-ready solutions. Your Skillset • 10+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Solutioning, Enterprise Architecture, or Solution Consulting roles. • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. • Strong expertise in enterprise technologies including Microsoft platforms, cloud solutions, CRM, ERP, AI, automation, and integration architectures. • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and AWS. • Strong understanding of enterprise applications including CRM and ERP solutions. • Experience designing AI-driven, automation, and RPA-enabled business solutions. • Proven expertise in preparing technical proposals, solution architecture documents, effort estimations, and architecture diagrams. • Strong client engagement skills with experience conducting workshops, presentations, demos, and advisory sessions. • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision-making. • Ability to work with enterprise customers on large-scale digital transformation programs and strategic initiatives. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities. • Passion for continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and competitive landscapes. • Relevant certifications in Azure, AWS, Enterprise Architecture, Dynamics 365, Salesforce, or cloud technologies are highly desirable. Why Level Shift? • Accelerate your career growth by working on enterprise-scale digital transformation and solutioning initiatives. • Gain hands-on exposure to cloud platforms, enterprise applications, AI, automation, and modern integration technologies. • Learn from experienced consultants, architects, and technology leaders in a collaborative and growth-focused environment. • Work alongside cross-functional teams that value innovation, customer success, and continuous improvement. • Solve real-world business challenges by designing scalable solutions that deliver measurable business value. • Access continuous learning opportunities, certification support, leadership development programs, and exposure to emerging AI-powered enterprise technologies.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Salesforce Data cloud
jobDescription: Are you passionate about architecting intelligent customer data solutions that drive personalized engagement and business growth? Join Level Shift as a Solution Architect – Salesforce Data Cloud , where you’ll lead the design and implementation of scalable Customer Data Platform (CDP) solutions that unify data, unlock insights, and enable data-driven marketing and personalization across the enterprise. In this role, you will collaborate with clients and cross-functional teams to architect data ingestion, identity resolution, and activation workflows—bridging technology and business strategy to deliver measurable impact. What You’ll Do As a Solution Architect at Level Shift , you will: Lead Salesforce Data Cloud Implementation: Own the end-to-end setup, configuration, and deployment of Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) to consolidate customer data across multiple systems. Gather & Analyze Requirements: Partner with business stakeholders to understand data sources, customer journeys, and business goals that inform CDP design. Design Data Ingestion Pipelines: Architect and implement data ingestion workflows from CRM, web, POS, marketing, and third-party systems using APIs and ETL tools. Configure Identity Resolution & Unification: Define and optimize Identity Resolution rules, Unification processes, and Data Model Objects (DMOs) to create a unified customer profile. Build Insights & Activation: Develop Calculated Insights , audience segments , and activation workflows that connect Data Cloud with external platforms such as Marketing Cloud , ad platforms, or analytics tools. Ensure Compliance & Data Governance: Apply consent and privacy rules in data modeling and activation processes to align with global compliance standards. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Marketing, IT, and Analytics teams to ensure seamless integration and business alignment. Optimize & Support: Troubleshoot data ingestion, unification, and activation issues, and provide training and technical guidance to end users and internal teams. Your Skillset We’re looking for a solution-driven architect with deep expertise in Salesforce Data Cloud and enterprise data integration. 5+ years in data architecture, data integration, or Salesforce ecosystem roles. Salesforce Expertise: Proven experience implementing and configuring Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP). Data Integration: Skilled in API-based data ingestion (REST/SOAP) and ETL tools for connecting diverse systems. Identity Resolution: Strong understanding of identity matching, unification logic, and data modeling best practices. Technical Skills: Data Ingestion & ETL Tools Salesforce Marketing Cloud Integration APIs & Data Integration (REST/SOAP) Data Modeling & Schema Design Identity Resolution & Matching Logic SQL & JSON Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) & DMPs Analytics & Reporting Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with consent management and data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA). Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Why Level Shift? Lead transformative data initiatives leveraging the power of Salesforce Data Cloud and AI-driven personalization . Collaborate with enterprise clients on complex data architectures that enable unified customer experiences. Work in a dynamic environment with cross-functional experts across Salesforce, Marketing Cloud, and Integration technologies. Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you’re ready to architect intelligent customer data ecosystems that deliver connected, personalized experiences at scale, apply now at joinus@levelshift.com and help shape the future of customer data with Level Shift!
